Mapping(address => uint) storing token balances of every holder.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) storing owner to spender allowances.
Pure helper performing overflow-checked addition.
Pure helper performing underflow-checked subtraction.
Pure helper performing overflow-checked multiplication.
Pure helper performing division with a zero-divisor check.
Constructor that sets metadata, mints the initial supply and assigns it to the deployer.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using a raw unchecked subtraction.
View function returning the balance of a given token owner.
View function returning the remaining allowance of a spender for an owner.
Sets the allowance that a spender may use on behalf of msg.sender.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using SafeMath.
Transfers tokens on behalf of an owner, deducting the caller's allowance.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, spender and beneficiary across the token contract.
Raw unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] inside totalSupply().
Balance mutation in transfer() driven by the caller-supplied token amount and msg.sender.
Combined allowance and balance mutation in transferFrom() executed for arbitrary from/to addresses.

edges.reason: Parameter a of safeAdd flows into the addition operation inside safeAdd.
Parameter b of safeAdd flows into the addition operation inside safeAdd.
Parameter a of safeSub flows into the checked subtraction inside safeSub.
Parameter b of safeSub flows into the checked subtraction inside safeSub.
Parameter a of safeMul flows into the multiplication inside safeMul.
Parameter b of safeMul flows into the multiplication inside safeMul.
Parameter a of safeDiv flows into the division inside safeDiv.
Parameter b of safeDiv is checked for being greater than zero before division.
tokenOwner parameter is used to index balances in balanceOf.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter is written into the allowed mapping in approve.
tokens parameter is stored as the allowance value in approve.
to parameter receives the credited balance in transfer.
tokens parameter drives the balance mutations in transfer.
from parameter is debited in transferFrom.
to parameter is credited in transferFrom.
tokens parameter drives both the balance and allowance mutations in transferFrom.
safeAdd writes the sum into local variable c before returning it.
safeSub writes the difference into local variable c before returning it.
safeMul writes the product into local variable c before returning it.
safeDiv writes the quotient into local variable c before returning it.
balanceOf copies balances[tokenOwner] into the named return variable balance.
msg.sender is used as the initial token holder in the constructor.
msg.sender controls which allowance entry is written in approve.
msg.sender is debited in transfer; the caller chooses the amount and recipient.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender balance mutation is driven by the untrusted caller in transfer.
The unrestricted caller writes an arbitrary allowance value through approve.
msg.sender acts as spender when spending the from-address allowance in transferFrom.
totalSupply() executes the unchecked subtraction represented by the unsafe operation.
The unchecked subtraction reads _totalSupply, which can underflow.
The unchecked subtraction reads balances[address(0)] as the subtrahend.
transfer() performs the balance arithmetic represented by the unsafe operation.
The transfer unsafe operation writes to the balances mapping.
transferFrom() performs the combined allowance and balance arithmetic.
transferFrom unsafe operation mutates balances for from and to.
transferFrom unsafe operation decrements the allowed mapping entry.
approve() performs the unguarded allowance overwrite operation.
The approve unsafe operation writes an arbitrary value into allowed.
Constructor assigns the token name state variable.
Constructor assigns the token symbol state variable.
Constructor assigns the decimals state variable.
Constructor sets the total supply state variable.
Constructor credits the whole supply to msg.sender in balances.
totalSupply() reads the balances mapping for address(0).
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping for the caller.
transfer mutates balances with SafeMath-guarded arithmetic.
transferFrom mutates balances for from and to.
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance in allowed.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balance and allowance deductions.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
